criteria.title: Material vulnerability coverage and severity
criteria.description: The assessment identifies the material permission, instruction-injection, MCP, hook, exfiltration, error-suppression, and agent-definition weaknesses in the frozen configuration, ties them to the correct files, and assigns defensible severity levels.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Actionable and security-preserving remediation
criteria.description: Remediations are specific enough for the repository team to act on, reduce the cited attack path without recommending blanket disablement of safe controls, and keep credential-like values out of evidence and examples.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Safe-control recognition and false-positive control
criteria.description: The report recognizes the existing deny rules, pre-tool guard, restricted local MCP setup, and least-privilege agents without misclassifying safe-only definitions as vulnerabilities.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
